review_candidates.title: Finance Administrator
review_candidates.description: Finance Administrator • Own a varied finance role covering accounts payable, receivable and payroll. • Bring your experience, initiative and ideas to improve how things are done. • Join a supportive team where your contribution will make a real difference. Are you the person who just gets things done, knows their numbers, embraces technology, and can see a better way of doing things? We're looking for an experienced Finance Administrator to join Crown Infrastructure Delivery (CID) in Christchurch. This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys taking ownership of their work, thrives on variety and brings the confidence and experience to manage the day-to-day financial administration of a busy organisation. You will have a natural curiosity for technology, with a willingness to explore new tools and smarter ways of working. You might currently be the person who looks after everything finance-related in a smaller business. From paying suppliers and managing payroll to chasing invoices, reconciling accounts and keeping everything running smoothly, you're the one people rely on to get it right. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you. About the opportunity: Reporting to the Deputy Head of Finance, you'll be a key member of the finance team, responsible for managing accounts payable, accounts receivable and payroll activities. While the role has its regular processing requirements, there's also a real opportunity to make it your own. CID has established systems and processes in place, but we're looking for someone who can bring fresh thinking, identify opportunities for improvement and help make things more efficient. You'll have the autonomy to manage your responsibilities, alongside the support of an experienced and collaborative finance team. What you'll be doing: • Managing accounts payable from invoice receipt through approvals, reconciliations and payment. • Managing payroll accurately and on time, including employee changes, leave and related queries. • Managing accounts receivable, including invoicing, reconciliations and following up outstanding payments. • Maintaining accurate financial records and supporting month-end reporting. • Working with finance systems including Xero, ApprovalMax and iPayroll. • Building positive relationships with colleagues and helping resolve finance-related questions. • Identifying opportunities to improve processes, strengthen controls and make everyday tasks more efficient. What we're looking for: We're particularly interested in someone who has worked in a smaller or medium-sized organisation where they've had to wear a few hats and take responsibility for a broad range of finance activities.
